reason: Q8 draft #693 leaves five canonical domains without a featured Valuable Reference; this independent source widening is discovery only.
method: Retrieved live upstream GitHub repository metadata, exact commit, nontruncated tree listing, SKILL.md entry text and root LICENSE; inspected special science attribution and per-file license. No complete per-package semantic grading, static security scan, behavioral test, installation, vendoring or admission.
scope_notes: GitHub code-search nonmatches in skillz are not a full semantic or mirror deduplication check.
'scope' reflects observed tree blobs, not a final authorized package boundary; ROS root includes ancillary tooling.
License texts were inspected at source pins. Per-asset and dependency rights and notices remain subject to full review.
The Q8 draft is not merged. Do not add these source leads to Q8 counts, canonical 25-source registry, featured shelf, dashboard, or governed exact-version review count.

leads.value: Measurement-led music/SFX placement, cue lists, offline mixes and loudness validation
leads.risk: Includes Python audio processing scripts and external reference files; input/music rights, host writes, and actual audio judgments need review; no execution.

leads.value: Require completed detection evidence rather than speculating about media authenticity
leads.risk: Needs hosted detection API key and potentially uploads private media; paid-service, privacy, false-accuracy and source-bias risks; authenticity is never proved by one score.

leads.value: Distinguish vision, mission, strategic objectives, priorities, actions and owners
leads.risk: Template can invent targets, performance claims, owners and dates unless every assertion is sourced and approved. Novelty and overlap need comparative review.

leads.value: Build truthful accomplishment stories from commits, PRs and explicitly confirmed impact
leads.risk: Requests private workspace/repository reads; consent and disclosure scope must precede git/gh commands. GitHub CLI may use network. Source uses permissive 'no permission theater' language.

leads.value: Identify an employer's actual ATS vendor before offering platform-specific resume advice
leads.risk: Unverified vendor-parser rules and claims; active public-board probes require bounded network/rate policy and source citation; don't invent vendor based on names.

leads.license: MIXED: root MIT, literature-search.md Apache-2.0 (separate LICENSE and ATTRIBUTION)
leads.value: Build an auditable literature collection with verified BibTeX, per-paper notes and a correction log
leads.risk: Attribution identifies forked/upstream content and Apache-2.0 file-specific obligations. PDF copyright and scholarly-access terms, external lookups and local writes need separate review.

leads.scope: 204 blobs in root repository tree; package-owned boundary not established
leads.license: Apache-2.0 (root text inspected; check nested/tool terms)
leads.value: ROS 2 engineering discipline: scope, non-actuating diagnostics, QoS, version-appropriate checks and evidence gates
leads.risk: Repository includes tooling, tests and hooks; establish exact package boundary. ROS hardware and actuator operations require safety authority and a representative versioned test environment.

leads.value: Layer unit, simulated, integration and hardware-in-loop tests instead of relying on one kind of robot test
leads.risk: Embedded ROS examples and hardware-in-loop commands remain unexecuted; real-robot actuation, safety stops and environment/version requirements need independent qualification.
